column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: one|other (only 1 is "one" in Dutch).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels, in neutral
# standard Dutch for the Netherlands and Flanders (the interface addresses the user as "je";
# software terminology follows the Dutch Microsoft/Apple style).
# Coverage: the whole interface: every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# name "Craft App Suite", app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft,
# DesignCraft, VectorCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft, WordCraft, DeckCraft, GridCraft, CADCraft,
# Trailing "…" (U+2026) must be preserved. Placeholders must appear in the translation:
